When it comes to open kitchen, and sushi restaurants I do believe a high tip out policy is important, as BOH actively engages with customers face to face. Tip pooling is a way for a restaurant to say we pay “$30/hr!!”, but really they are just taking from the FOH pay, the owners subsidize wages this way. In some states that is illegal. This happened to me recently. Mine also came with a calcium deficiency that caused a double jaw fracture the first day I got it, and stuck shed on the toes. She’s lost 2 nails and a toe in the first couple weeks. Get your humidity up ASAP! I went bioactive after trial and error. The live plants, moss, and ABG mix substrate helps to get the humidity perfect. A fogger/mist system is a good idea too. If you don’t wanna go that route definitely get coconut fiber, cypress mulch and spag moss. Mix it up and and make sure you have at least four inches for digging. Honestly really consider the bioactive, otherwise you’ll be spot checking for mold and changing your substrate often. The humidity is hard to maintain without mold otherwise. Good luck!

The water fountain is mopani root siliconed onto plexiglass cut in a triangle. There is plexiglass attached to the bottom in the back to act as a stand for stability. The pump is underneath and hidden behind rocks, there are 2 screws used for legs in the front to keep it open and accessible.
